method: German web searches, venue-owned pages and official regional tourism. Bounded corroboration sample for broad OSM import; not a comprehensive list. No coordinates invented. A current website is not a physical operating-status inspection.

directories.scope: Flensburg and nearby fjord; distinguish outside-city destinations

directories.note: Older reference; recheck venue-owned sources for moves and closures
